mapper.sql: SELECT t.monthly_id, t.year_month, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.org_id, t.attend_days, t.late_count, t.early_count, t.absent_days, t.leave_days, t.overtime_hours, t.night_shift_count, t.high_temp_days, t.sealed_status, t.sealed_by, t.sealed_time, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name AS org_name FROM biz_hr_attendance_monthly t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_attendance_monthly SET del_flag = '2' WHERE monthly_id = #{monthlyId}
